title: FIU vs. Liberty: Week 9 Betting Odds, Prediction
text:
FIU vs. Liberty: Week 9 Betting Odds, Prediction Football Basketball ACC Big 12 Big Ten Pac-12 SEC Newsletter COLLEGE FOOTBALL FIU vs. Liberty: Week 9 Betting Odds, Prediction
 Andrew Pistone College Sports Wire Oct. 31, 2026, 6:08 a.m. ET Flames head coach Jamey Chadwell has led the Flames to a 6-1 overall start and 3-0 record so far in Conference USA games, which has opened the door for some exciting possibilities down the road if they can maintain their form. Liberty has won six consecutive games after a blowout loss to James Madison in Week 1.
 FIU has found the going a little more difficult, as the Golden Panthers lost their last two games in heartbreaking fashion. They came up just short in a 27-24 loss against Jacksonville State, and had the short end of the stick in a 26-23 defeat against Middle Tennessee State.
 If you are looking for some betting advice for the matchup, we've got you covered. Here are the latest odds for the game, courtesy of BetMGM.
 FIU vs. Liberty game odds:
 All college football odds via BetMGM
 Love crosswords? Explore the Crossword page and play the new MidGrid Crossword. Spread: FIU +14 (-110), Liberty -14 (-110)
 Money Line: FIU +430, Liberty -580
 Over-Under: Over 45 (-110), Under 45 (-110)
 FIU vs. Liberty prediction, pick:
 The positive way to spin FIU's recent games is that they have been right on the doorstep of victory, and that a win might be due to them in the near future. However, they're going to need quarterback J.J. Kohl to do a better job protecting the football, as his eight interceptions are the most in the conference.
 Meanwhile, the Flames have raced out to a strong start with a very specific formula that has worked wonders for them. Liberty has the fewest passing yards in Conference USA, but the most rushing yards. This usually means that a quarterback's dual-threat rushing ability is bolstering a team's overall rushing output, but that isn't the case here.
 Liberty legitimately has multiple options at running back that have played well, led by Kam Davis's seven yards per carry and five touchdowns. Peyton Jones and Jaylon Coleman have also figured prominently into the run game. There's no reason to think the Flames' rushing prowess won't continue in this contest as well.
 Prediction: Liberty 34, FIU 21
 Best Bet: Over 45
